why: The founder's ruling of 28 October 2026, item 6: any sentence, Why? text or rationale that says or implies a cloud provider documents a behaviour carries the page's URL, the exact sentence quoted and the date read. The kit takes the shape of arvaken/mark's check (mark#914). A claim cites its entries by id, [source: id], in the README or in a comment or docstring, never in words a customer is shown. tests/test_provider_claims_name_their_source.py fails the build on a claim with no source.

fields.url: the page, https, on the provider's own host
fields.sentence: the sentence (or list, table row or entry) quoted whole, no ellipsis
fields.about: what the sentence is about, in the provider's own terms
fields.read: the day it was read, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC)

aws-agentcore-stop-session-terminates.page: Stop a running session - Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
aws-agentcore-stop-session-terminates.sentence: When called, this operation instantly terminates the specified session and stops any ongoing streaming responses.

aws-agentcore-streaming-limit.page: Quotas for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore - Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
aws-agentcore-streaming-limit.sentence: Streaming maximum duration | 60 mins | No | Maximum time for streaming connections (Response streaming, WebSocket connections)
aws-agentcore-streaming-limit.about: a runtime's invocation limits: how long one streaming response may last (a table row)

aws-agentcore-http-container.page: HTTP protocol contract - Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
aws-agentcore-http-container.sentence: Your agent must be deployed as a containerized application meeting these specifications: Host : 0.0.0.0 Port : 8080 - Standard port for HTTP-based agent communication Platform : ARM64 container - Required for compatibility with the AgentCore Runtime environment
aws-agentcore-http-container.about: the HTTP protocol's container requirements (a list, quoted whole)

aws-agentcore-healthy-busy.page: HTTP protocol contract - Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
aws-agentcore-healthy-busy.sentence: While the status is HealthyBusy, the runtime session is considered active and is kept alive.

aws-agentcore-ping-last-update.page: HTTP protocol contract - Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
aws-agentcore-ping-last-update.sentence: Do not set time_of_last_update to the current time on every ping.

aws-agentcore-trust-policy.page: IAM Permissions for AgentCore Runtime - Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
aws-agentcore-trust-policy.sentence: The AgentCore Runtime execution role must include the following trust policy which allows the AgentCore Runtime to assume the role.
aws-agentcore-trust-policy.about: the trust policy of a runtime's execution role, with its conditions on aws:SourceAccount and aws:SourceArn

aws-cloudtrail-event-history.page: Working with CloudTrail event history - AWS CloudTrail
aws-cloudtrail-event-history.sentence: The event history provides a viewable, searchable, downloadable, and immutable record of the past 90 days of management events in an AWS Region.
aws-cloudtrail-event-history.about: CloudTrail's event history: management events, by Region

owed.why: Claims on the kit's main branch when the check came: each is sourced by 4 November 2026, after which the build fails if any is left. The list only shrinks.
